notes: All five demos were built as standalone index.html files with inline CSS and no local asset dependencies.
No downloaded directory photos were used because image rights/provenance were not sufficiently clear.
Static structural QA was performed. Browser/render/responsive QA and direct live verification were not available in the execution environment, so none are marked LIVE_DEMO.
Two source conflicts in opening hours were found for Mrdak and Beauty Bojana; exact hours were removed from public copy rather than guessed.
Maligator Pet Shop initially qualified, but its GitHub file write was blocked by the tool safety layer; it was replaced by Auto Servis Delibasic without forcing the write.
